A0012.title: Forced Password Reset
A0012.definition: Issuing a mandatory password reset to the user; the user must successfully reset their password before they can log in.
A0012.description: Mandatory password reset is typically applied in scenarios such as successful credential stuffing logins, password leakage, logins from unusual locations, long-term inactivity, password expiration, and unchanged default passwords. Its primary purpose is to verify account ownership through the password reset process and the identity authentication (A0018) performed during it, thereby reducing the risk of compromised user credentials.
A0012.limitation: The mandatory password reset process itself relies on secondary identity authentication. If an attacker has already gained control of the victim's mobile verification code or email account, they can directly hijack the account during the password reset step. Additionally, triggering mandatory password resets at scale significantly impacts normal user experience, which can easily lead to complaints and user churn.

references.title: Authenticator Requirements: Forced Password Change after Compromise - NIST SP 800-63B
